topics.title: The April evening and the wife's comments

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the relaxed April-evening setting with which the poem opens.
Interpret the wife's comments and the husband's ironic withdrawal from them.

topics.title: The son's demand and the parents' rapport

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the seven-year-old son presents his demand for dinner.
Interpret the parents' unspoken agreement that children must be disciplined.

topics.title: The child's logic and the resolution

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse why the child's argument about hunger seems logical to the father.
Explain how the wife's laughter resolves the scene and unites the family.
Identify the use of understatement, irony and asides in the poem.
Explain how the idyllic setting is juxtaposed with ordinary domestic matters.
Recall key facts about the poet Nissim Ezekiel.
State the form and rhyme scheme of a limerick.
Interpret the punch line in the limericks given with the chapter.
